name: confirm-pressed-twice
pins: A second Confirm click is a no-op. Live, it was not: the reschedule step re-entered after its own commit, auto-proposed the earliest free slot, and the second click moved an appointment the patient had chosen to a time they were never shown - two `appointment_rescheduled` audits eighteen seconds apart. Three things are pinned together, because any one of them alone can pass while the bug stands. `audit_actions` counts the commits, and is the only assertion that can see the intermediate move at all: the appointment's final status is `confirmed` either way. `proposed_action: null` after the first click says the run did not put itself back up for confirmation. And the third turn's reply is the nothing-to-confirm template, which is what a stale click is supposed to produce.

turns.message: please reschedule my appointment to next week
